task: Stop the Resource Observatory inspector from presenting an unreported loop iteration count as zero

recommended_vehicle.rationale: A focused component test provides a deterministic pass or fail signal for this bounded presentation defect.

recommended_pattern.rationale: The loop must stop as soon as the focused inspector test passes and may not exceed three iterations.

decision.notes: Maximum three iterations; 30 minute and 8000 token budgets; evidence per iteration; human review required before merge.
